description: This file defines a SwiftUI ViewModifier named StatusGlassCardModifier that provides a styled background and overlay for UI components, as well as an extension to View for applying this modifier conveniently. The focus is on creating a translucent glass-like card with customizable padding and brightness effects.

classes.name: StatusGlassCardModifier
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that styles content with a glass-like background, border, and shadow, dynamically adjusting border opacity based on environment contrast setting.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the layout and styling for the content, including padding, background with rounded rectangle, overlay stroke, and shadow.

methods.name: statusGlassCard
methods.description: Extension method to apply the StatusGlassCardModifier to a view with specified parameters.
